component.name: mdSilo
component.summary: Local-first Markdown knowledge base, book reader and feed reader

description.p: mdSilo brings Markdown notes, a book reader, RSS feeds and an issue tracker together in a local-first workspace. Link notes, books and ideas, explore their graph, and keep your work in plain files.
This community package downloads and repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified. Updates are delivered through Flatpak.
Open a workspace through the file chooser to grant access to that folder. Settings and feed data are stored in the app's private data directory.
For a workspace outside the file chooser, grant its folder explicitly:

ul.li: Allow a folder: flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/workspace com.mdsilo.mdSilo
